scope: Only the source-defined approach interval is eligible for scoped alignment review. The referenced screening and visual-review reports retain full-clip failures and explicit acceptance decisions.

constraints.wrist_mount_fit: lateral XY only where >=3 source training detections; axial/roll retained

limitations: Conditional transfer of reference intrinsics, distortion, wrist roll/axial placement, fixture scale.
Color/scale grooves and template cap centers are heuristic image evidence, not ground truth.
A static CAD pad cannot reproduce tissue deformation; PSM2 uses retained LND surrogate CAD.
Wrist XY offsets are conditional on inherited optical roll and axial placement; a static cap cannot distinguish those freedoms.
A 5mm pad-height prior and a conservative wrist-head-above-slit-plane barrier prevent buried-tool depth degeneracy; neither is measured contact evidence.
Depth and metric accuracy remain unvalidated; inspect all four actual mesh overlays.

pad_placement.prior_metrics_scope: fit_metrics, constrained_fit and scene_fit.metrics describe the predecessor pad placement; camera/global reference transforms are unchanged
pad_placement.base_scope: scene_fit.base describes the original native pad geometry before the separate rigid translation

playback_scope.scope: Image alignment is evaluated for this source-defined static phase; later full-clip errors remain reported.
